title: Funky Ehh
blurb: A groove, a grunt, and somehow an entire wave of dance edits. What makes it work is that the ehh stops being a vocal noise and becomes a percussion instrument: it lands on the beat, it carries the rhythm, and your brain files it next to a snare rather than a voice. Taking something meaningless and building a functioning trend on top of it is the internet's oldest skill. Silly and danceable and impossible to hear once without nodding along to at least part of it.
origin: A viral dance-edit sound built around a rhythmic 'ehh'.
